}

3. Set entry control MSRs with bits required to always be 1 if bit 55 of VMX_BASIC is off; adjust high and low control bits accordingly.
4. Initialize CPU-based control MSRs, allowing certain features even if not supported directly by the hardware.
5. Set secondary CPU-based control MSRs, optionally enabling nested EPT if supported.
6. Read and adjust VMX_MISC MSR values for proper configuration.
